turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Of course. Fill in the gap with the right form of the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
Once you have answered, you could also write two short sentences about a friend's weekly routine, using he or she, to stretch it further.
